t_advice_summary_textbox.text: the colour of the gnomes matter to which forest they take you too. this then matters on how many mushrooms you receive. work out which colour in which pair takes you to the most giving forest and this will maximise it, this changes but you can work it out.

vb_textbox.text: Honestly, I am unsure of any pattern. The main thing i did was try and correlate the shape and colour of the gnome and get that again on a x5 multiplyer. To begin with i ascertained this by alternating my S and K keys and then changing it up if that gnome gave me a low score. I enjoyed it and just say get into a rhythm and try and remember the gnome significances. certain gnomes with certain basket colours give their highest amount. just enjoy it!
